component.name: Mark Shot
component.summary: Native screenshot, annotation and recording tool for Wayland and X11
原生截图、标注与录屏工具

description.p: Mark Shot captures the screen instantly and opens an interactive fullscreen overlay for cropping and annotating the result. It was written for Wayland compositors such as niri and covers the usual X11, GNOME, KDE and wlroots desktops as well. Since 0.2.0 it is a native Rust application with its own lightweight renderer.

ul.li: Pen, highlighter, shapes, arrows, text, numbered markers, mosaic, blur, a ruler and a pixel magnifier with colour readout
Scrolling capture, and pinning any crop as a frameless floating sticker
Copy to the clipboard or save to disk, with a capture history
Scan a QR code or barcode straight out of the selection
Record a region or a display to MP4, MKV or GIF, with system audio, microphone, pause and resume
Offline OCR (PP-OCRv5) with table export, and translation through Bilibili, OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, Tencent, Baidu or Youdao endpoints

Your compositor may keep its privileged capture protocols from sandboxed apps; Mark Shot then captures through the desktop portal, which may ask for permission the first time. On Plasma Wayland the KWin ScreenShot2 path is used.
The OCR runtime and models are downloaded the first time you use OCR.
Hovering a window to select it asks the compositor directly (niri or Sway IPC, a KWin script on Plasma), which is not reachable from the sandbox; drag a region instead.

description.p: A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Save screenshots outside ~/Pictures and ~/Downloads: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/dir io.github.jswysnemc.MarkShot

screenshot.caption: The editor over a selected region, with the annotation and action toolbars

description.p: More delayed-capture presets in the tray menu, an optional persistent recording panel, direct arrow heads and refined arrows, shapes and shadows, and toolbar tooltips. Fixes slow selection tracking on Cinnamon X11 and image clipboard transfers on X11/Xwayland. The new launch-at-login setting is not available in the Flatpak build.

A complete rewrite in Rust: no Qt runtime, a built-in software renderer, native Wayland, X11 and KDE backends, a new recording engine, offline PP-OCRv5 OCR and more translation providers. Now also built for aarch64.
On-demand text selection on pinned stickers, a themed screenshot history window, HiDPI crosshair scaling, and RapidOCR model lookup aligned with the model downloader.
Redesigned OCR result window with separate text and translation panes, a streamlined recording dialog, and a reworked settings form layout.
